title: Stage Lift
summary: Program the hydraulic pillars of a concert stage with matrix sums and scalar multiples so a free-runner lands every jump.
subject: mathematics
concepts: Adding and subtracting matrices entry by entry
Building a matrix from a rule for aᵢⱼ
Multiplying a matrix by a scalar
Solving a matrix equation such as 2X + B = C
Two matrix equations in two unknown matrices
Unknowns inside the entries of a matrix
learningOutcome: The student can add, subtract and scale matrices, solve matrix equations such as 2X + B = C or a pair X + Y = P, X − Y = Q, and find unknowns from matching entries.

levels.title: The second program
levels.adds: Baseline: matrices of the same order add entry by entry, so if A + Y = C then Y = C − A; the boss subtracts instead (Ex 3.2 Q1, Q4).
hints: Work one pillar at a time: the entry in row i, column j of A + Y is aᵢⱼ + yᵢⱼ.
So each entry of Y is the card’s entry minus the base program’s entry.
In the boss round the stage computes A − Y, so yᵢⱼ = aᵢⱼ − cᵢⱼ.

levels.title: Master gain
levels.adds: New: a scalar multiplies every entry, so 2X + B = C gives X = ½(C − B), and 3X − B = C gives X = ⅓(C + B) (Ex 3.2 Q1, Q8).
hints: kX multiplies every entry of X by k.
Move B to the other side first, entry by entry, then divide by the scalar.
Watch the signs: B − 2X = C means 2X = B − C.

levels.title: Two crews
levels.adds: New: two unknown matrices. Add or subtract the two equations: X + Y = P and X − Y = Q give X = ½(P + Q), Y = ½(P − Q) (Ex 3.2 Q7).
hints: Treat the two matrix equations like a pair of ordinary equations.
Adding them removes Y; subtracting them removes X.
Check one pillar of each stage with your X and Y before showtime.

levels.title: Hidden letters
levels.adds: New: the unknowns are letters inside the entries; matching entries give equations in x, y, z and t to solve (Ex 3.2 Q9 to Q12).
hints: Two matrices are equal when every matching entry is equal.
Write one equation per entry of the card, then solve for the letters.
When two letters share entries, solve the pair together, as in x + y = 5 and x − y = 1.

levels.title: Rule cards
levels.adds: New: the card is a rule for its entries, such as cᵢⱼ = |i − 3j|; build the matrix entry by entry, with i for rows and j for columns (Ex 3.1 Q4, Q5).
hints: i is the row number and j the column number.
Work out c₁₁, c₁₂, c₁₃ for the back row, then c₂₁, c₂₂, c₂₃ for the front row.
Watch the signs: (−1)^(i + j) is +1 when i + j is even.

misconceptions: Matrices of different orders can be added
In 2X + B = C you can divide by 2 before moving B
X − Y is the same as Y − X
